description: This file defines a custom Android UI component 'LogView' that extends TextView and implements LogNode. It is used to display log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting them with priority, tag, message, and optional exception details, and appending them to the UI. It includes methods for handling log message chaining and text appending.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView subclass used to display formatted logs received via the LogNode interface.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView with different parameter sets for context and attributes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, then appends it to the LogView and passes it to the next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the provided string as a new line in the LogView.
